perspectives.description: A transparency view for machine learning models following the industry-standard model card structure, covering model details, intended use, training data and procedure, quantitative analysis, technical limitations, and ethical and environmental considerations.

A view for assessing readiness for the post-quantum cryptography migration, covering cryptographic inventory, quantum resistance of the cryptography in use, and cryptographic agility. Catalog document contributed separately (CycloneDX/specification#960).
